description: Fired when the user presses Save on a dirty draft. Persist event.holiday with system.user.editHoliday, or addHoliday when the gateway has no holiday of that name (on a rename — oldName present — edit under the old name with the new model) and refresh the data.holidays binding. Capability flags only hide UI: a crafted client can send this event with any payload, so check the session user's roles and re-read the flags here on the gateway before writing (see the adminAuth reference library). isNew is only a UI hint a crafted client can set to anything: work out whether a save creates from gateway data (system.user.getHolidayNames()).

holiday.description: The flat HolidayModel mirror: { name, date: 'YYYY-MM-DD', repeatAnnually }.

isNew.description: True when this save comes from the create flow. A UI hint only, so don't decide what to write from it: work out whether the save creates from gateway data. Use it only to report a conflict instead of overwriting a holiday that already has this name.

oldName.description: Present only on a rename: the holiday's previous name (pass it as editHoliday's first argument).
